This '''male''' individual was the co-pilot of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Vidar Kim]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. In [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]], he died in a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] accident over [[Kaadara]], a city on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], along with [[Vidar Kim's wife]] and one of his [[Vidar Kim's first son|sons]].
